question: Where is the nearest café toward the east side starting from J P Riddle Stadium, Fayetteville, NC?
sql: SELECT poi_name FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_DWithin( geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%J P Riddle Stadium%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Fayetteville%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NC%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 50000 -- Search within a reasonable radius, e.g., 50km ) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%J P Riddle Stadium%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Fayetteville%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NC%' LIMIT 1 ), geometry )) BETWEEN 67.5 AND 112.5 ORDER BY geometry <-> ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%J P Riddle Stadium%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Fayetteville%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NC%' LIMIT 1 ) LIMIT 1;
